help_text:
owa-graph me - Profile, photo, manager, direct reports

Shortcuts:
  whoami         Show the signed-in user (GET /me)
  photo          Print the signed-in user's photo bytes to stdout
  manager        Show the signed-in user manager
  directreports  List direct reports

Common flags accepted by every shortcut:
  --pretty   Human-readable output (table for known shapes, indented JSON otherwise)
  --ndjson   Stream collection items one JSON object per line
  --retry    Honor Retry-After once on 429/503
